Add Claude to your call and get work started as you talk

Claude Meetings lets you add Claude to a Google Meet call as a visible participant. The team can ask questions out loud or in chat, and Claude writes the notes and action items so no one on the call has to. It builds docs, whiteboards, and other artifacts during the call, and teammates on the invite can edit them as you talk. After the call, the notes, transcript, and anything Claude made are on the meeting page in Claude. It is in beta on Team and Enterprise plans, starting with Google Meet.

Hey PH community 👋

Excited to hunt Claude Meetings today.

Anthropic just shipped Claude Meetings, a beta that puts Claude on your team's video call as a visible participant. They say it follows the conversation, answers questions out loud or in chat, and builds docs, whiteboards, and other artifacts with you while you're still talking. Claude also writes the notes and action items, so no one on the call has to.

Anthropic posted a short look at it on X here: [...] Anthropic posted a short look at it on X here: 

Live artifacts is the part I'm most excited about. You can ask Claude to start a doc or put the plan on a whiteboard during the call, and teammates on the invite can edit what it makes while you keep talking.

Questions in the room is the other one I'd test first. Someone can ask Claude what last year's event cost, and with permission it looks it up in your connected tools, posts the answer in the meeting chat, and compares it to the plan you're building.

The meeting page is what makes the work stick. After the call, the notes, action items, transcript, and anything Claude built all live in Claude, and you can go back and ask about meetings you were part of.
